existingFixParts.note: Primary replacement part when the pintle is stuck or the coil is out of spec (cleaning is tried first). This is the SOHC D16 1.6L 6th-gen (EK/EM1 era) valve — Honda 'Valve Set, Rotary Air Control', Denso-made (138200-0560). Genuine Honda runs ~$180-230; quality aftermarket (Standard/Denso) ~$32-70.
existingFixParts.component: Idle Air Control Valve (IACV) — 1996-2000 Civic (D16Y5/D16Y7/D16Y8, 1.6L)

existingFixParts.note: Era-correct IACV for the 7th-gen 2001-2005 Civic 1.7L (D17A1/A2/A6/A7). Different casting/connector than the 1996-2000 P2J valve — this is the correct number for the later half of the issue's year range. Genuine ~$180-250; aftermarket ~$35-60. Do NOT cross with the 96-00 36450-P2J-J01.
existingFixParts.component: Idle Air Control Valve (IACV) — 2001-2005 Civic (D17A, 1.7L)

existingFixParts.note: Seals the IACV to the throttle body; should be replaced whenever the valve is removed for cleaning or swapped (old one tears/leaks unmetered air and re-triggers a hunting idle). Fits Civic 1990-2000 D-series. For 2001-2005 D17 the IACV gasket differs and is commonly supplied with the 16022-PLC valve
existingFixParts.component: IACV / Rotary Air Control Valve mounting gasket (1996-2000)

existingFixParts.note: Needed if the throttle body is removed from the intake manifold to fully clean the bore and ports as the FIX describes. Genuine Honda throttle-body gasket for 96-00 Civic 1.4/1.6 SOHC. Reuse-once gaskets should be replaced to avoid a post-repair vacuum/idle leak. Era-correct 1996-2000.
existingFixParts.component: Throttle body mounting gasket (1996-2000)

existingFixParts.note: Consumable required by the FIX to dissolve the carbon fouling on the IACV pintle, throttle plate and idle bypass ports. No Honda OEM PN — CRC 05078 is the canonical throttle-body cleaner (~$7-11). Use a spray-safe cleaner on the valve; avoid soaking electronics. confident on the product, oemPartNumb
existingFixParts.component: Throttle body / air-intake cleaner (carbon-fouling consumable)
aftermarketXref: CRC 05078 Throttle Body & Air-Intake Cleaner (12 oz)
CRC 05379 QD Electronic Cleaner (for the IACV coil/pintle)

entries.component: radiator
entries.repairRoleEvidence: Replace the radiator, then repeatedly flush both the cooling system and the transmission to remove all emulsified fluid

existingFixParts.note: The primary repair part. The in-tank ATF cooler is inside the radiator, so a new radiator is what actually stops the coolant/ATF cross-contamination. 19010-PLC-901 is the Denso OEM AT radiator for the 7th-gen (EM2/ES) 1.7L automatic. Aftermarket units under DPI/TYC #2354 fit the same application. OE
existingFixParts.component: Radiator assembly with integrated ATF cooler — 7th gen (2001-2005 Civic, 1.7L automatic)

existingFixParts.note: Same fix for the far-more-searched 8th-gen (FA/FG) 1.8L R18 automatic. 19010-RNA-A51 is the Denso (Japan-built) AT radiator; 19010-RNB-A51 is the US-built (Toyo) equivalent for the same car — verify by build plant. Aftermarket cross DPI/TYC #2989. Do NOT use a 7th-gen -PLC number here. OEM ~$300-340
existingFixParts.component: Radiator assembly with integrated ATF cooler — 8th gen (2006-2011 Civic, 1.8L automatic)

existingFixParts.note: ERA-CORRECT fluid: 2001-2011 Civic automatics call for Honda ATF-Z1 (08200-9001), NOT the later ATF-DW1 (08200-9008). Multiple full flushes are needed to purge emulsified fluid, so budget several quarts (transmission holds ~3 qt drain / ~7 qt total). Priced per quart. Idemitsu Z1 is the OE-supplier
existingFixParts.component: Automatic transmission fluid (for repeated post-repair ATF flushes)

existingFixParts.note: Honda Type 2 (blue) pre-mixed 50/50 coolant, the correct spec for 2001-2011 Civic. The cooling system must be flushed repeatedly to clear the pink emulsion; budget 1-2 gallons. Honda-specific silicate/amine-free chemistry — no true generic cross-ref; use Honda Type 2 only. OL999-9011 is being supers
existingFixParts.component: Engine coolant (for repeated cooling-system flushes)

existingFixParts.note: Aftermarket-only part (no Honda OEM PN — this is a DIY modification, so oemPartNumber intentionally empty). Many owners add an external plate/fin or tube-and-fin ATF cooler and bypass the in-radiator cooler so a future radiator failure can never contaminate the transmission again. Tru-Cool LPD47391
existingFixParts.component: External inline ATF cooler (recurrence-prevention mod — bypass the in-radiator cooler)

existingFixParts.note: The actual fix: 1/4" closed-cell foam wedged in the center of the deck to load the plastic shelf, between the third-brake-light plastic and the glass, and under the wiring/cable pass-throughs. Forum-verified as the most effective DIY remedy (CivicX/10thCivicForum). Not an OEM PN — sold by dimension.

existingFixParts.note: Applied along all edges of the rear shelf where plastic contacts metal/glass, per the dealer foreman fix and forum DIYs. 3M 5430 (PN 06356, 1in x 3yd) is the canonical squeak-reduction tape, ~$20. Verified real 3M part number. Felt tape is an equivalent generic substitute.
existingFixParts.component: Felt / squeak-reduction tape for shelf edges (3M UHMW squeak tape)

existingFixParts.note: Optional/advanced: remove plastic deck cover and apply CLD deadener to the rear deck sheetmetal and underside of trunk lid to kill resonance. Dynamat 10435 (~$105) verified; cheaper butyl (Kilmat/Noico) works equally. Sorbothane domes are a forum-proven alternative that fully eliminated the rattle i

entries.component: valve cover gasket
entries.repairRoleEvidence: Replace the valve cover gasket and spark-plug tube seals (and grommets)

existingFixParts.note: Primary repair part for the 1.7L D17A (D17A1/A6/A7) SOHC engine in the 2001-2005 Civic. Genuine Honda PN 12341-PLC-000, era-correct for the 7th gen. Reusable gasket, but replace when hardened/leaking.
existingFixParts.component: Valve cover (cylinder head cover) gasket — D17 engine (2001-2005 7th-gen)

existingFixParts.note: Primary repair part for the 1.8L R18A SOHC i-VTEC in the 2006-2011 (8th-gen) Civic. Genuine Honda PN 12341-RNA-A01 (fits 2006-2015 Civic). Era-correct — do NOT use the D17 12341-PLC-000 on R18 cars.
existingFixParts.component: Valve cover (cylinder head cover) gasket — R18 engine (2006-2011 8th-gen)

existingFixParts.note: The round spark-plug well/tube seals that harden and let oil pool in the plug wells. Need 4. Honda PN 12342-RYE-004 is the long-running D-series/1.7L tube seal. Often bundled in aftermarket VCG sets (Fel-Pro VS50606R).
existingFixParts.component: Spark-plug tube seals — D17 engine (2001-2005), qty 4

existingFixParts.note: R18 uses a coil-on-plug tube seal (Honda calls it 'seal, spark plug tube' / coil seal) PN 30522-RNA-A01, era-correct for 2006-2011 Civic. Qty 4 — replace when oil is found in the plug/coil wells.
existingFixParts.component: Spark-plug tube seals — R18 engine (2006-2011), qty 4

existingFixParts.note: Rubber grommet-washers under the valve cover bolts (qty 5) on the D17. Replace with the gasket — hardened grommets are a common secondary seep point. Honda PN 90442-PLC-000, era-correct 2001-2005.
